shortDescription: Manage custom images on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: firmware_type
options.description: The firmware type that will be used for servers created with this image.

options.name: force_retry
options.description: Retry the image import even if a failed import using the same name and URL already exists. This is necessary to recover from download errors.

options.name: name
options.description: The human readable name of the custom image. Either name or UUID must be present to change an existing image.

options.name: slug
options.description: A string identifying the custom image for use within the API.

options.name: source_format
options.description: The file format of the image referenced in the url.

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags assigned to the custom image.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL used to download the image.

options.name: user_data_handling
options.description: How user_data will be handled when creating a server. There are currently two options, "pass-through" and "extend-cloud-config".

options.name: uuid
options.description: The unique identifier of the custom image import. Either name or UUID must be present to change an existing image.

options.name: zones
options.description: Specify zones in which the custom image will be available (e.g. C(lpg1) or C(rma1)).
